acceptance_criteria: OBS-03 audit rows written on create/delete in tenant schema
description: TC-EXT-02-INT-08 (Create/delete operations write OBS-03 audit rows atomically) fails with PgError.ServerError at ext02_webhook_dispatch_test.zig:681 when querying webhook_subscription_audit or related audit table. The test expects audit rows to be written atomically on subscription create/delete. Either the audit table does not exist in the tenant schema, a required column is missing, or the query is using wrong schema context.
title: TC-EXT-02-INT-08: PgError.ServerError querying OBS-03 audit rows for webhook subscription
